meta.title: Home-front session
meta.purpose: Help a free U.S. preparedness group practice continuity when a Taiwan Strait crisis degrades services at home.
meta.licenseNote: BLACK MERIDIAN is free. The intended outcome is living people and closed planning gaps, not a product sale.

ethics: Talk about services failing, not how to break them.
Do not name real plants, bases, bridges, hospitals, or warehouses as targets.
Do not store names, addresses, account numbers, or medical identifiers.
Official alerts beat this dashboard in a real event.
Plans that help in storms, outages, and pharmacy delays still help if the extreme case never happens.

roles.title: Facilitator
roles.job: Keep time, release one inject at a time, stop targeting talk, write the three commitments.

roles.title: Households
roles.job: Each person or pair represents one household. Use a callsign, not a real name.

roles.title: Mutual-aid cell
roles.job: Track what the group can share without collapsing: water, transport, check-ins, spare meds knowledge (not actual prescriptions).

roles.title: Information cell
roles.job: Say what is confirmed, rumored, or unknown. Prefer official public sources.

roles.title: Civil picture
roles.job: Track power, water, fuel, comms, medical access, and payments as effects on people, not as attack surfaces.

session.title: Boundary and region
session.do: Read the ethics list. Pick one U.S. planning region. State that named countries are a public scenario frame, not a forecast or a targeting board.

session.title: Baselines
session.do: Each household fills the planner. Mutual-aid cell records surplus and shortages without addresses.

session.title: Four home-front injects
session.do: Run H-01, H-03, H-04, and H-05 (or swap H-02 / H-06). After each inject, every household answers: stay, move, share, or wait — and why.

session.title: Close three gaps
session.do: Group picks three high-consequence gaps to close in the next 14 days. Export the session log.

injects.title: Warning without certainty
injects.theater: Taiwan Strait: open-source and official U.S. statements disagree on whether PLA activity is coercion, an exercise, or open conflict.
injects.home: News and social feeds disagree. Stores are still open. Neighbors ask what you are doing. Nothing official has ordered you to leave.
injects.decision: What does each household do in the next 24 hours without treating rumor as fact?
injects.effect: Early choices spend cash, fuel, attention, and trust. Panic buying can empty a town faster than a real shortage.
injects.facilitator: Reward a written contact tree and a buy-list cap. Punish certainty theater. Do not discuss attacking infrastructure.

injects.title: Movement gets expensive
injects.theater: Japan, the Philippines, or insurers limit transit and raise rates on Taiwan-adjacent shipping. Chip and energy cargoes slip.
injects.home: Fuel prices jump. Some long-haul goods arrive late. A relative in another region wants a ride or a spare room. Roads are open.
injects.decision: Do you travel, host, stay put, or split the household? What is the fuel and cash limit?
injects.effect: Distance becomes a resource. Unwritten hosting rules create conflict inside the group.
injects.facilitator: Force a number: gallons or dollars they will spend this week. No real addresses.

injects.title: Phones and data go ugly
injects.theater: Cable congestion, cyber noise, and overloaded U.S. networks make official guidance late. Some channels still work.
injects.home: Cellular data is congested. Some texts go through hours late. Television and a weather radio still work. Rumors fill the gap.
injects.decision: How does the group check on each other tonight if apps fail? Who is the out-of-area relay?
injects.effect: Untested backup comms are not comms. Isolated people make worse shelter and medical choices.
injects.facilitator: Have them actually write the check-in hour and the backup method. If it is untested, mark it as a gap.

injects.title: Clinics and pharmacies slow down
injects.theater: Taiwan and nearby ports face civilian movement. U.S. clinics and pharmacies begin to slow.
injects.home: Routine appointments slip. A pharmacy is out of one common medication. Emergency rooms are busy. Power is still mostly on.
injects.decision: Who in the group has a time-critical medical need, and what is the 14-day workaround that does not require a hospital?
injects.effect: Medical delay, not battlefield injury, is how many households fail first.
injects.facilitator: No diagnosis details. Status only: confirmed / partial / none. Point people to their clinician and official public-health guidance.

injects.title: Pay, fuel, and restock lag
injects.theater: U.S. and partner magazine depth, tankers, and industrial surge look oversold. Tempo cannot be kept.
injects.home: Card payments flake at some stores. Cash still works. One grocer is short on staples. Fuel is available with longer lines. Work schedules slip.
injects.decision: What does the group share, what do they not share, and how many days of water and food remain after helping?
injects.effect: Mutual aid without a floor bankrupts the givers. Hoarding without a neighbor plan isolates the takers.
injects.facilitator: Ask for a sharing rule: keep X days, share the rest. Never inventory someone else's real address or stash.

injects.title: The story and the bill
injects.theater: A viral video of a contested incident near Taiwan contradicts official U.S. and PRC accounts.
injects.home: Local arguments get bitter. Insurance, rent, and work paperwork still matter. Some people want to relocate; others cannot. Officials ask the public to ignore unverified clips.
injects.decision: What sources will this group trust, and what 30-day housing / income / care plan survives if the argument never resolves?
injects.effect: Narrative shock splits groups that never wrote a recovery plan.
injects.facilitator: Do not wargame information operations. Reward a short source list: local EM, NWS, utility, Ready.gov, and one out-of-area human.

closeRules: Pick at most three gaps. More than three is a wishlist, not a plan.
Each commitment needs an owner callsign, a due date within 14 days, and a test (not a purchase alone).
A test means you used the radio, drove the fallback, filled water, or called the out-of-area contact.
Re-run the session after the 14 days. The score is closed gaps, not battlefield victory.
